_about: Public-domain James Buchanan (1804-1870, Free Church of Scotland, professor of systematic theology at New College, Edinburgh) for the Word Hoard: The Doctrine of Justification (1867), The Office and Work of the Holy Spirit (1842), Comfort in Affliction (1844), Faith in God and Modern Atheism (1855, 2 vols) and Analogy Considered as a Guide to Truth (1864), raw Internet Archive OCR from Princeton scans. CCEL and Gutenberg hold none of it. Added 2026-10-02 by lane A, round 6 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.
